sample_unit: comparison tables (one human Option Grid, four LLM tables, one Google search table)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated comparison tables versus human Option Grid
links.effect: The human-generated Option Grid had superior readability; LLM tables may be less readable and require additional checking and editing.
links.quote: The human-generated Option Grid had superior readability.

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of LLM-generated clinical content versus expert Option Grid
links.effect: Accuracy was 97% for the ChatGPT models and OpenBioLLM-70b and 95% for OpenBioLLM-8b and the Google search process; several tables omitted alternative interventions.
links.quote: Accuracy, compared to the human Option Grid, was 97 % for the ChatGPT models and the open-source OpenBioLLM-70b, and 95 % for OpenBioLLM-8b and the Google search process.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to scale production of evidence-based patient decision aid comparison tables with fact-checking and editing

screen.reason: Evaluated the accuracy and completeness of LLMs in generating patient-facing shared decision-making comparison tables compared to human gold standards, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
